Measure & map (1 week)  - Use Bob’s funnel queries (GA4 => BigQuery) to identify largest drop-off steps and compute baseline conversion by step.\"","\"Reduce form fields: avoid unnecessary address confirmations,\""],"gaps":["No complete Proposal 2 (missing subsequent steps, acceptance/QA criteria, rollout plan).","No Proposal 3 content (only a prioritization heading exists).","Acceptance/QA criteria are missing or incomplete for Proposal 2 and Proposal 3 would be missing entirely.","Overall, only Proposal 1 is fully defined; the artifact does not meet the requirement of 2–3 complete proposals mapped to research_findings.md and baseline_metrics.md."]}{"guidance":"Produce a revised document named improvement_proposals.md that contains 2–3 fully fleshed proposals. Ensure each proposal includes: (a) Goal, (b) Why prioritized, (c) Expected effect on defined metrics with numerical targets mapped to research_findings.md/baseline_metrics.md, (d) Implementation steps with owners and rough timelines, (e) Rough effort (Low/Med/High), (f) Dependencies, (g) Acceptance / QA criteria with measurable success metrics, (h) Rollout & monitoring plan and rollback. Complete Proposal 2 (Checkout Flow Simplification) and add Proposal 3 (Accessibility + Automated QA Pipeline) with full content. Align all metrics and baselines to the referenced research and metrics files, and ensure the document is ready for engineering/stakeholder handoff."}
